signature_comparison_scope.memory_sql_and_memory_source_sync: Legacy unordered semantic group signature only: statement/conditions/negations/valid_time/uncertainty/reality and whole group membership; does not compare permission/source envelopes or result order. Native application validation and dedicated functional tests cover these separately.
signature_comparison_scope.memory_retrieval: Full normalized unit/scope/source/group/visibility/verification/budget/omission envelope; both ordered and content hashes for two-stage/context/withdrawn results. First-negative lexical tie order depends on generated IDs, so content hash only there.
signature_comparison_scope.knowledge_sql: Full query result except verified dynamic imported_at; both ordered and content hashes.
signature_comparison_scope.knowledge_reference: Native check on every package; full state/query/project/principal envelope, ordered and content hashes; only dynamic imported_at, validated per-DB seal and registered-root-derived fingerprint normalized.
